text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I spot Narita Taishin in front of the academy gates, but she seems a little deflated.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I've been getting through my races fine, so what are you complaining about? I'm not some weakling!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Shut it. I don't need you sticking your nose in my business!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (What's wrong with me? I'm so tired and moody, and I'm lashing out at everyone.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (Maybe I am feeling down… I should rest a little…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We part ways, but Narita Taishin is in low spirits as she slinks off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her exhaustion must be catching up to her. Looks like I need to rethink her race schedule.
